scope: Source-derived matrix-product volumes normalized to dense B1H16S4096D512. Not hardware work counters or a latency prediction; excludes pointwise work, transfers, reductions and padding. Causal pruning changes the domain; boundary tiles add overhead.
arithmetic_scope: Selected backward retains FP32 probabilities when constructing centered dS; Gluon uses rounded probabilities there. The additional pointwise precision work is not included in the matrix-product volume comparison.
